status: original content written for this project; not human-validated
intro: To begin, could you tell me about yourself: your background, what you have worked on, and what draws you to {role} work?

questions.text: Tell me about a time you worked closely with other people to deliver something. What was your part in it?
Describe a project where the result depended on several people. How did you make sure the work fitted together?
Can you give an example of helping a teammate who was stuck, or of asking a teammate for help?
Tell me about a team you enjoyed working in. What made it work, and what did you contribute to that?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a colleague about how to do something. What happened?
Describe a situation where two people wanted different things from your work. How did you handle it?
Have you ever had to give a colleague feedback they did not want to hear? How did you approach it?
Tell me about a disagreement that you think you handled well, or one you would handle differently now.
Tell me about a time you took ownership of something that nobody had asked you to take on.
Describe a situation where you had to guide or organise other people without being their manager.
Give me an example of a decision you made on your own and what came of it.
Tell me about a time you were responsible for an outcome that mattered. How did you make sure it happened?
Tell me about the hardest problem you have solved recently. How did you approach it?
Describe a time you had to make progress with incomplete information. What did you do?
Give me an example of a bug or failure you tracked down. How did you find the cause?
Tell me about a time you chose between two possible solutions. How did you decide?
Tell me about a time the requirements or plan changed in the middle of your work. What did you do?
Describe a time you had to learn a new tool or skill quickly to get something done.
Give me an example of working in a situation that was unclear or changing. How did you cope?
Tell me about a time you had to change your mind about an approach.
Tell me about a time you had to deliver under a tight deadline. How did you manage it?
Describe a situation where several things needed your attention at once. How did you decide what came first?
Have you ever had something go wrong when the stakes were high? What did you do?
Tell me about a time you kept going on a difficult piece of work. What helped?
Tell me about a time you had to explain something complex to someone without the same background.
Describe a time a misunderstanding caused a problem in your work. How did you sort it out?
Give me an example of presenting or writing up your work for other people. How did you decide what to include?
Tell me about a time you asked questions to understand what someone really needed.
Tell me about a time something you worked on did not go as planned. What happened?
Describe a mistake you made at work or in a project. What did you do about it?
Give me an example of feedback you received that was hard to hear. What did you do with it?
Tell me about something you would do differently if you could repeat a project.
Why are you interested in this kind of role?
What do you hope to learn or achieve in your next role?
Tell me about a piece of work you were proud of and why it mattered to you.
What parts of this role do you expect to find hardest, and how would you prepare for them?
